import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}customer-banks`;// Get all customer banks
const getCustomerBanks=async params=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params:{...params,limit:+(params===null||params===void 0?void 0:params.limit)||50}});return response.data;};// Delete customer bank
const deleteCustomerBank=async bankId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(`${API_URL}/${bankId}`);return response.data;};// Update customer bank
const updateCustomerBank=async(bankId,bankData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(`${API_URL}/${bankId}`,bankData);return response.data;};// Create new customer bank
const createCustomerBank=async bankData=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,bankData);return response.data;};const customerBankService={getCustomerBanks,deleteCustomerBank,updateCustomerBank,createCustomerBank};export default customerBankService;
